description: Test the siren sound for 5 seconds at the specified volume.

requestBody.name: volume
requestBody.description: The volume for testing the siren sound. Defaults to the configured device volume.

local.python:
import http.client
import json


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("192.168.0.1")
payload = json.dumps({
  "volume": 0
})
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
conn.request("POST", "/proxy/protect/integration/v1/sirens/{id}/test-sound", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
local.ansible:
- name: Test siren sound
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.protect:
    path: "/v1/sirens/{id}/test-sound"
    method: POST
    body:
      volume: 0
  register: result


- debug:
    var: result.data
